[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - AKTA Chromatography Run Report

1. Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

2. Start & End Date

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End / Report Date: [[REPORT_DATE]]

3. Methods

3.1 Automated Workflow Description
  1. Manual Preparation
    • The system was paused with the instruction: "Manually fill sample loop" prior to starting the AKTA run.
  2. AKTA Pure Chromatography Run
    • The predefined AKTA Pure method was executed automatically.
    • Online monitoring signals recorded included UV (uv1) and conductivity (cond) at 1 Hz sampling interval.
3.2 Run Parameters
Parameter Value / Placeholder Description
EQUILIBRATION_DURATION [[EQUILIBRATION_DURATION]] Column equilibration duration.
EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE [[EQUILIBRATION_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during equilibration.
LOAD_INJECT_DURATION [[LOAD_INJECT_DURATION]] Duration of sample loading / injection.
LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE [[LOAD_INJECT_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during sample loading / injection.
ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_DURATION]] Duration of the elution gradient.
ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_START]] Starting buffer composition (e.g. %B) for the gradient.
ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END [[ELUTE_GRADIENT_GRADIENT_END]] Final buffer composition (e.g. %B) for the gradient.
WASH_DURATION [[WASH_DURATION]] Post-elution wash duration.
WASH_FLOW_RATE [[WASH_FLOW_RATE]] Flow rate during wash.
CIP_DURATION [[CIP_DURATION]] Main cleaning-in-place (CIP) duration.
CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION [[CIP_2_HOLD_DURATION]] Hold duration for CIP step 2.
CIP_3_DURATION [[CIP_3_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 3.
CIP_4_DURATION [[CIP_4_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 4.
CIP_5_DURATION [[CIP_5_DURATION]] Duration of CIP step 5.
